description: Exports a page with its metadata. format='json' (default) returns { title, tags, visibility, version, summary, model, contenido (HTML), ... }; format='html' returns the stored HTML. `version` can be sent back as expectedVersion when republishing. Other users' pages: only public ones, marked as third-party content (json: thirdParty and thirdPartyNotice; html: a notice block before the HTML). Read-only.

overwrite.description: true = overwrite file_path if it already exists

slug.description: Page slug/path; hierarchical paths are allowed (e.g. 'briefings/today')

user.description: Page owner username (default: the connected account)

name: outbox_export
title: Outbox: export a page
